responsibility: This shared definition file is the master table of AArch64 system registers known to GCC and kept in sync with Binutils. Each `SYSREG` entry records the assembler-visible register name, architectural encoding fields, behavioral flags such as read-only or alias properties, and the ISA feature requirements, allowing assembler parsing, builtin validation, and other target code to derive consistent system-register lookup and feature gating from one source.
